# **Yes! You can make 40s – 60s MP4 videos! 🎬**

We have built a complete **MP4 Video Creation Studio & Engine** in this workspace, fully optimized for short-form video platforms (**TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts**).

---

### 🌐 View the Live Video Studio & Player
You can watch the sample video and create your own directly here:
👉 **[Open Live MP4 Video Studio](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/320ec274-2c1d-47d8-8b6f-6b49c62431f4/9bcbf8a577f25ea359d516e4/)**

---

### What’s Included in Your Project:

#### 1. 🎥 Pre-Rendered 45-Second Demo Video ([sample_45s.mp4](https://github.com/rohitchaurasiya723-cell/can-you-make-mp4-vdos-40s-60s/blob/main/sample_45s.mp4))
* **Resolution**: `720x1280` (9:16 vertical mobile format)
* **Duration**: Exactly **45 seconds** (1,350 frames @ 30 FPS)
* **Codecs**: Standard **H.264 High Profile** video + **Stereo AAC** audio
* **Instant Streaming**: Fast-start atom (`-movflags +faststart`) configured so it streams immediately on iOS Safari and mobile browsers with zero buffering lag.
* **Content**: 
  - **Scene 1 (0–11s)**: The Hook ("Can AI Make 40s–60s MP4 Videos?") with pulsing neon glow & particle physics.
  - **Scene 2 (11–23s)**: Value & virality stats (+380% watch time on Reels & Shorts).
  - **Scene 3 (23–35s)**: Automated multi-layer rendering pipeline.
  - **Scene 4 (35–45s)**: Call to action with dynamic countdown and channel badge.
* **Music Track**: Synchronized 124 BPM electronic synthwave beat synthesized mathematically with kick, snare, hi-hats, bassline, chord pads, and scene-transition risers.

---

#### 2. 🎨 Interactive In-Browser Studio ([index.html](https://github.com/rohitchaurasiya723-cell/can-you-make-mp4-vdos-40s-60s/blob/main/index.html))
Open the live link on your phone or desktop to:
* **Customize Durations**: Choose **40s, 45s, 50s, or 60s**.
* **Select Color Themes**: *Cyberpunk Neon*, *Solar Sunset*, *Emerald Tech*, or *Midnight Violet*.
* **Edit Script & Scenes**: Type your own hook headlines, bullet points, and call to action.
* **Live Audio Playback**: Plays procedural synth beats in real time via the Web Audio API.
* **Export Video Button**: Uses `canvas.captureStream()` and `MediaRecorder` to record and download a custom video file right to your device.

---

#### 3. 💻 Automated CLI Script ([generate-video.js](https://github.com/rohitchaurasiya723-cell/can-you-make-mp4-vdos-40s-60s/blob/main/generate-video.js))
You can generate videos programmatically via terminal or server:

```bash
# Generate a 45-second vertical MP4:
node generate-video.js 45 public/my_video_45s.mp4

# Generate a 60-second video:
node generate-video.js 60 public/my_video_60s.mp4
```

All changes are committed and live in your repository. Check out the [README.md](https://github.com/rohitchaurasiya723-cell/can-you-make-mp4-vdos-40s-60s/blob/main/README.md) for full documentation!
